messages:
olivia: Starting SummitBank POC thread. Their checklist: SAML SSO (Okta/Azure), SCIM v2 provisioning for users + nested groups, per-tenant RBAC that matches their internal job-level roles, and tenant domain binding so only bank emails can sign up. Also they insist on assertion encryption and want EU data residency. Need: demo date, Hosted vs Dedicated implications, and any blockers.

ryan: Quick summary: Hosted supports SAML (signed assertions), SCIM over HTTPS, and group->role mapping. Encrypted SAML assertions + per-tenant key management require Dedicated/Private (we can enable a KMS-backed key pair). EU residency requires Dedicated in eu-west or Private deploy.

meera: Security/GRC asks: audit logs retention (12 months), immutable logs export, KMS envelope wrapping, SCIM audit trail, and proof of SAML metadata validation. Legal also wants the standard DPA + DPIA if we go Dedicated.

ben: Pricing/ops note: Hosted enterprise plan covers most features for the POC; Dedicated adds setup + monthly capacity commit. Ballpark: Dedicated ~1.7-2x Hosted unit cost and 30-90 day provisioning depending on capacity. If they need encrypted assertions immediately, Dedicated is the path.

olivia: On SCIM they asked if roles can be provisioned directly rather than via groups. We normally map groups -> Redwood roles, but we can accept a custom SCIM extension attribute `urn:com:redwood:role` for direct role assignment with a small mapping change. That will need sign-off.

ryan: For SCIM testing ask them for SCIM base URL, admin token or client creds, sample user payloads, and one example of a nested group. Note we flatten nested groups into membership lists for RBAC mapping. Mentioned gotchas: Azure sometimes uses `onPremises` attributes, Okta uses the standard urn SCIM schema.

meera: On SAML flows: we support both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated. They require signed AuthnRequests and strict clock skew checks. For assertion encryption, Hosted cannot accept encrypted assertions with our current per-tenant keys; Dedicated supports encrypted assertions with KMS-managed keys. We'll need to document that clearly for them.

infra-bot: Automated: staging-saml-connector provisioned (id: sconn-2160). Metadata URL: https://staging.redwood-inference.com/saml/metadata/sconn-2160

ben: Domain binding procedure: we give them a TXT token to add to DNS for the domain they want bound. Once validated we lock signup to that domain and enforce email claim checks in SAML assertions. If their DNS team won't add TXT records, alternate verification via an approved security alias email is possible but less preferred.

olivia: Main blockers I see: 1) Legal sign-off for EU hosting or DPA acceptance, 2) their security team providing IdP test creds and a SCIM admin token, 3) decision Hosted vs Dedicated (pricing + timeline), 4) if they insist on encrypted assertions immediately, we'll need Dedicated, 5) DNS changes for domain binding.

ryan: Demo scheduling: they want a walkthrough next Thursday and a full POC in 3 weeks. If SummitBank hands over IdP metadata and SCIM creds by Monday, we can demo SAML login + basic SCIM sync next Thu. Full RBAC mapping and domain lock will take the full 3 weeks.

meera: I'll prepare the security response doc (audit retention, encryption details, KMS notes) and the DPA/DPIA template. Ben, can you draft the mapping examples (group->role + attribute-based rules) and a sample SCIM user JSON?

ben: On it. Example RBAC mapping I'll send: `Summit_Admins -> org.admin`, `Summit_Tellers -> app.teller`, plus rule: `if department=credit -> role app.credit-analyst`. Sample SCIM payload I'll include with nested group example.

olivia: Action items: olivia -> request IdP metadata + SCIM creds + DNS contact from SummitBank; meera -> security/DPA; ben -> mapping + SCIM sample; ryan -> stage SAML connector and enable verbose logs. I'll update when SummitBank replies. :white_check_mark:
